svg.title: Whole GPU or GPU partitions
svg.desc: Discrete Device Assignment dedicates one physical GPU to one VM. GPU partitioning divides one physical GPU into supported equal partitions assigned to multiple VMs. The illustration shows four example partitions, not a hardware support claim. A physical GPU uses one mode at a time. DDA does not support live migration; maintenance requires a supported stop/restart workflow. GPU-P live migration is conditional on the exact supported hardware and software configuration.
svg.text: Read the left column, then the right. Compare alternatives, not sequential states.
